d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Charlotte is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Charlotte Kaiser is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Charlotte kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Charlotte's gone." Dhrubo looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Charlotte." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Panom blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d41: The fire knew Panom before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
